U.S. officials accused Salvadoran forces of failing to coordinate operations, endangering international troops and hitting the U.S. embassy with gunfire.
El Salvador rejected the allegations and questioned the credibility of top U.S. diplomat David Howell.
It insisted its operations were coordinated and that Trump had personally approved the escalation.
Source: Axios
